BiblicalUsage: Arod is named once, as a son of Gad, and the census gives his name and his family and nothing more. His descendants are counted among the tribes at the edge of the promised land.
TheologicalSignificance: A name in a census with no story of its own still matters, because God counts His people family by family, and no son of Gad is left out of the number.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
